name: Tu Shen-yen
bio: Tu Shen-yen was a T’ang poet who lived between the seventh and eighth centuries; he is generally identified as the grandfather of Tu Fu.
The poem here is Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu’s version in The Jade Mountain (1929), given with the poet’s name as spelled here.

poems.title: On a Walk in the Early Spring
poems.author: Tu Shen-yen
poems.note: Harmonizing a Poem by My Friend Lu Stationed at Ch'ang-chou
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Only to wanderers can come
Ever new the shock of beauty,
Of white cloud and red cloud dawning from the sea,
Of spring in the wild-plum and river-willow. . . .
I watch a yellow oriole dart in the warm air,
And a green water-plant reflected by the sun.
Suddenly an old song fills
My heart with home, my eyes with tears.

poems.title: 蓬萊三殿侍宴奉敕詠終南山 (Peng lai san dian shi yan feng chi yong zhong nan shan)
poems.author: Tu Shen-yen
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
北斗掛城邊，南山倚殿前。
雲標金闕回，樹杪玉堂懸。
半嶺通佳氣，中峯繞瑞煙。
小臣持獻壽，長此戴堯天。

poems.title: 送崔融 (Song cui rong)
poems.author: Tu Shen-yen
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
君王行出將，書記遠從徵。
祖帳連河闕，軍麾動洛城。
旌旗朝朔氣，笳吹夜邊聲。
坐覺煙塵少，秋風古北平。

poems.title: 和晉陵陸丞早春遊望 (He jin ling lu cheng zao chun you wang)
poems.author: Tu Shen-yen
poems.collection: 唐詩三百首 (Three Hundred Tang Poems)
poems.text:
獨有宦遊人，偏驚物候新。
雲霞出海曙，梅柳渡江春。
淑氣催黃鳥，晴光轉綠蘋。
忽聞歌古調，歸思欲沾巾。
